title: HealthReport
description: Uniform liveness and readiness payload returned by every Rinne service. The web service's manifest page renders this, and smoke-test.ps1 asserts against it, so the shape is a contract and not a convenience.

service.description: Which Rinne service produced this report.

status.description: ok: fully serving. degraded: serving with a failed non-critical dependency. down: not serving.

version.description: Build identifier. Set from the image tag at deploy time.

checkedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of this check, produced at request time and never cached.

revision.description: Cloud Run revision name, from the K_REVISION environment variable.

region.description: Deployment region, for confirming the asia-southeast1 decision holds in production.

detail.description: Short operator-facing note. Never contains a stack trace, an internal hostname, or a credential.

dependencies.description: Downstream checks this service performed. Bounded so a compromised or buggy downstream cannot inflate a response.
